description:
Read an existing canonical snapshot into context. Fast — no LLM calls.

WHEN TO USE: When you need the current canonical state document for a topic (e.g. architecture, auth, glossary) without generating a new one.

snapshot_id.description: Specific snapshot UUID. Either topic or snapshot_id required.

topic.description: Topic to fetch canonical snapshot for. Either topic or snapshot_id required.

name: get_snapshot
